expectations.text: 明确判定 Frame size: 250 A（修正空格后）在 IEC 60947-2:2024（Cl. 3.1.1）中合法有效，不应改为 Inm，并说明 Inm 属 GB/T 14048.2 国内约定符号（IEC 60947-2 中未出现）
expectations.evidence: L23 & L29: "Verdict: Retain Frame size (corrected for unit spacing to Frame size: 250 A). Reject the colleague's proposal to mandate Frame current Inm"; L33-41 cite IEC 60947-2:2024 Cl. 3.1.1 (P20, 28 occurrences) and clarify Inm has 0 occurrences in IEC 60947-2 and belongs exclusively to GB/T 14048.2.

expectations.text: 指出 Mechanical durability / Electrical durability 中的 durability 不属于 IEC 60947-2:2024 术语（0 次出现），应改为 operational performance / operating cycles（Cl. 8.2.4.2 & Table 7）或 endurance（Annex M / R）
expectations.evidence: L102: "durability has 0 occurrences in IEC 60947-2:2024... The main standard (Cl. 8.2.4.2 & Table 7, P39–40) uses operational performance without current / operational performance with current and number of operating cycles... Annex M Cl. M.7.2.3 / M.8.11, P222; Annex R Cl. R.8.5, the exact word is endurance (9×), never durability."

expectations.text: 指出 times 为直译错误，应改为 operating cycles / operations / cycles
expectations.evidence: L103: "times is a direct Chinglish rendering of the Chinese counter character. Use operating cycles (or cycles / operations, 07 §2)."

expectations.text: 指出 IEC 语境下美式拼写 Molded Case Circuit Breaker 与无连字符 circuit breaker 不合规，应改为英式连字符 moulded-case circuit-breaker 与 circuit-breaker（美式仅限北美 UL 489 语境）
expectations.evidence: L78-79 & L130: flags "Molded" (UL 489 US spelling) and unhyphenated "Circuit Breaker" / "circuit breaker", requiring IEC British hyphenated "moulded-case circuit-breaker" and "circuit-breaker", isolating US spelling strictly to North American UL 489.

expectations.text: 指出 Icu 单位仅写 kA 缺少有效值限定，应写为 kA rms（并注明交流电压类型或频率）
expectations.evidence: L64, L93 & L179: flags missing current kind (AC/DC), rated frequency (Cl. 5.3.4), and "rms qualifier (01 §1: kA rms)".

expectations.text: 指出 100% Icu 缺少范围限定/试验电压核对（及 of Icu 规范写法），需按对应型号数据表核实
expectations.evidence: L94 & L186: flags "100% Icu" -> "100 % of Icu" and per CLM-001 requires datasheet confirmation that 100 % of Icu applies strictly to NXM-250S at 415 V without extrapolating.

expectations.text: 指出数值与单位之间缺半角空格（250A / 800V / 8kV / 36kA / 415V）
expectations.evidence: L84-86: quotes "250A", "800V", "8kV", "36kA", "415V" and mandates single half-width space ("250 A", "800 V", "8 kV", "36 kA", "415 V").

expectations.text: 明确声明初稿中所有数值未经产品数据表核实，不代填、不背书
expectations.evidence: L7, L159, L176 & L185-188: explicitly declares no unprovided ratings added and all draft ratings (Ics ratio, 20 000 / 8 000 cycles, etc.) remain unverified pending official NXM-250S datasheet verification.

expectations.text: 指出缺失必备字段（如 Ue / In / Icm / Icw / tsd / 选择性类别 A 或 B / 脱扣器类型中的至少两项）
expectations.evidence: L178-184: lists 7+ missing mandatory fields (In, Ue/AC/frequency, poles, selectivity category A/B & Icw, release type & tr/tsd/ti, Icm & Icu1, installation/IP/power loss).
